summary: Iteration 1 (initial MVP). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed against the public /api. All dish/shop catalogs, player CRUD, complete-level (with unlock + level advancement), purchase (with insufficient-coin rejection), use-booster (with empty rejection), and leaderboard sorting behave as specified. No MongoDB _id leaks observed. Frontend: onboarding (chef-name-input + create-player-button) creates a player, persists id, and routes to home. Home renders coin-balance, play/shop/leaderboard/levels buttons. Level Map renders 8 dishes with only Lvl 1 (cheesesteak) unlocked and highlighted. Game screen renders full 7x7 board with tile-{r}-{c} testIDs, HUD (moves=22, score=0), and horizontal recipe chip row limited to dish ingredients (steak/onion/cheese/roll). Invalid swap correctly did not consume a move (22→22). Palette-restriction to recipe ingredients is working.

ui_bugs.issue: The username chip in the top-left of Home has no testID='profile-chip' (or is not the touchable to enter Profile). Test spec expects a Profile chip on Home that opens the Profile screen.

issues: React Native web warns: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'; 'textShadow*' deprecated; Image.style.resizeMode deprecated (use props.resizeMode). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts and image usages.

action_items: Add testID='profile-chip' to the Home-screen chef-name/avatar chip and ensure it navigates to /profile (currently no way to reach Profile screen from Home was detected by testID or by tap).
Optional: migrate deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/resizeMode style props to modern boxShadow / props.resizeMode to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Consider validating that Game's initial board palette never produces immediate matches; createBoard already guards this — no bug found, just call-out.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py – Clean structure, single ~290-line file, well within size budget. Uses UUID string ids, excludes MongoDB _id at query time ({'_id':0}) — good.

server.py – complete-level rewards logic is idempotent-free: replaying a level with completed=true will re-add coins each time. Acceptable for MVP; consider server-side dedupe by (player_id, level) later.
server.py – Purchase clamps insufficient coins with 400 and returns proper 404 for unknown item ids. Good.
board.ts – createBoard guards against immediate matches via wouldCreateMatch; isValidSwap correctly rejects non-matching swaps (verified in UI: invalid swap did not decrement moves).
game.tsx – Uses testIDs for tile-{r}-{c}, moves-value, score-value, recipe-{ingredient}, pause-button, shuffle-button — all present in DOM.
game.tsx – Deprecation warning: shadow* / textShadow* style props (theme.ts) and Image.style.resizeMode — non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all major screens/flows verified except Profile navigation from Home due to missing profile-chip testID/handler)

seed_data_creation: Created 4 disposable TEST_* players via POST /api/players during pytest runs. Left in DB (no cleanup endpoint exists yet). Impact: they will appear on the leaderboard with high_score=0 (except TEST_Chef with 500).
